title: Autumn Hearth Glow

diffuser.notes: Run 20–30 min in a well-ventilated room; cinnamon is potent, keep it low.

spray_optional.note: Shake well before each use; avoid fabrics and wood.

why_it_works: Warm citrus and soft spice evoke a cozy hearth, while clary sage adds a gentle herbal calm for crisp autumn days.
safety: Avoid eyes/mucosa; keep from children & pets.
Consult a professional if pregnant, nursing, or under care.
